headline: Similar weather is not enough for similar yields: the southern Buenos Aires departments whose weather falls within the Corn Belt range yield about half of their U.S. analogs.
note: Argentina is shown as an extension test: there is no yield estimate here yet, because the model was trained on U.S. counties. Each department is compared with the U.S. counties that have the most similar weather, and with its own official yields (MAGyP). Similar weather does not mean similar yield.

rules.zone_cerca: comparison shown with the out-of-range measures
rules.zone_fuera: say that U.S.-trained estimates would not apply
rules.magyp: comparison only, never a model input
